thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 Incident created: SEV2 - routing-policy-runtime-exception. Trigger: policy-engine panic causing routing fallbacks and variant thrash. Pager sent to on-call.sre and eng-runtime.

emily_sre: paging — I'm seeing increased 5xxs and a loop of region fallbacks for a subset of EU requests. Customers report wrong model variant returned.

jordan_oncall: on it. joining. can someone drop a quick example request id?

emily_sre: req_id=02f3a9d4, path=/v1/generate, customer=acme-eu. headers show region=eu-west-1. Response went to model=redwood-7b-compat-v1 (should be redwood-7b-compat-eu).

lina_eng: grabbing logs from policy engine. looks like an exception during rule evaluation, then fallback policy selected default route -> which then fails capacity -> region fallback triggers again. loop.

ops_bot: @jordan_oncall attached policy-engine logs (last 200 lines).

lina_eng: paste of stack snippet: ```
panic: runtime error: index out of range [0] with length 0

goroutine 72 [running]:
github.com/redwood/inference/policy.(*Evaluator).evalRule(
    /workspace/policy/evaluator.go:214 +0x1b3)
main.(*PolicyEngine).routeRequest(
    /workspace/policy/engine.go:412 +0x2f5)
```

emily_sre: ugh. that matches the trace I saw earlier. probable nil/empty list assumption in rule expression.

jordan_oncall: severity? customer impact?

sam_support: multiple EU customers reporting increased latency (~3-6s) and occasional model mismatch (responses from older variant). 5 major customers with >100 failed requests in last 10m.

maria_reliability: mark SEV2, potential breach of SLO for dedicated customers in eu region. Notify sales for affected accounts.

lina_eng: quick mitigation plan: 1) disable the problematic routing policy (keep global default), 2) pin critical customers to known-good variant, 3) hotfix eval to guard empty arrays.

jordan_oncall: agree. can we disable via control plane without deploy? redwoodctl has policy toggle.

lina_eng: yes. command: ```
redwoodctl policy update --id=policy-873a --state=disabled --reason="incident: runtime exception causing fallback loop"
```

emily_sre: I'm running that now (will post output).

emily_sre: (after) -> ✅ policy policy-873a disabled. traffic should stop hitting the policy engine for that rule.

ops_bot: routing table snapshot after change: default route -> redwood-7b-compat-eu pinned for region eu. No more fallback candidates for that policy.

sam_support: customer-facing note: "We're investigating degraded performance in EU; we've applied a mitigation and are monitoring. Will update in 30m." Posted to impacted customers.

jordan_oncall: can you pin the 5 affected customers to a stable variant? command sample: ```
redwoodctl customer update --id=acme-eu --route-model=redwood-7b-compat-eu --scope=dedicated
```

lina_eng: applying pins now in parallel. ops_bot will verify route table entries.

ops_bot: confirmation: acme-eu, beta-co-eu, fintech-x have routes pinned to redwood-7b-compat-eu.

maria_reliability: good. what's ETA on fix?

lina_eng: code fix is small: guard for empty list in evaluator and add unit test for that rule shape. I can cut a patch/PR in 20m and hot-restart the policy engine binary in non-disruptive way.

emily_sre: monitoring dashboards show 95th latency dropping back to baseline after disabling policy. still some error spikes as pinned requests stabilize.

jordan_oncall: I'll start an on-call handoff plan. @lina_eng you remain the incident lead for the eng fix. @maria_reliability handle comms and post-incident summary. @sam_support keep customer updates flowing.

lina_eng: creating PR: `fix/policy-eval-empty-list-guard` -> CI run started. patch diff snippet: ```diff
- if items[0].Match(...) {
+ if len(items) > 0 && items[0].Match(...) {
```

lina_eng: merging once tests pass, then rolling binary restart on canary hosts first.

incident-bot: Update: CI passed for PR #4219. Deployment queued to canary.

ops_bot: Canary rollout succeeded on 3 hosts. Policy engine CPU stable. No further panics in canary logs.

emily_sre: rolling to remainder of instances with 5% steps. watching for regressions.

sam_support: customers reporting improved behavior. latency back to normal for pinned customers.

maria_reliability: prepare postmortem checklist items: timeline, root cause (assumption of non-empty list in rule eval), impacted customers, mitigation steps, follow-ups (validation harness for policy expressions, defensive coding standard, automated canary for policy deployments).

jordan_oncall: handoff notes for next on-call: monitor policy-engine error-rate, confirm no new fallback loops, and ensure customer pins are still active for 24h.

lina_eng: follow-ups I'm assigning: - add schema validation for policy expressions (pre-deploy) - add more exhaustive eval unit tests - instrument rule input shapes in tracing for faster triage

emily_sre: final check: last 30m errors for policy engine = 0 panics, 2 transient eval warnings. latency stable.

incident-bot: Incident SEV2 resolved -> mitigation applied, patch rolled, customers informed. Please file postmortem and label with tags: policy-engine, routing, fallback-loop, europe.

jordan_oncall: resolved. handing off to next on-call for overnight watch. good job everyone. :clap:
